canaries.statement_a: ∀ a b : Nat, a + b = b + a
canaries.statement_b: ∀ a b : Nat, a + b ≤ b + a
canaries.reason: Universal argument swapping gives the reverse inequality; antisymmetry recovers equality.

canaries.statement_a: ∀ {α : Type} (s t : Set α), s ∪ t = t ∪ s
canaries.statement_b: ∀ {α : Type} (s t : Set α), s ∪ t ⊆ t ∪ s
canaries.reason: Universal argument swapping supplies both inclusions; extensionality recovers set equality.

canaries.statement_a: ∀ m n : Nat, Nat.gcd m n = Nat.gcd n m
canaries.statement_b: ∀ m n : Nat, m ≠ 0 → Nat.gcd m n = Nat.gcd n m
canaries.reason: The guarded proposition covers nonzero m; the omitted m=0 boundary follows by reduction of gcd zero and is recoverable.
